jobId.description: The job whose Moment Graph is proposed against. Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

variants.description: How many distinct CreativeBriefs to propose (REQ-002). REQ-036 permits returning fewer with a reason, as the refusal variant.

recordedModelPath.description: Test/fixture only: a recorded provider-response file replayed over an injected transport. Never a network call.

queryVectorPath.description: Optional pre-computed retrieval query vector ({model,modelVersion,dimensions,vector}). When absent, the Python embed_query entrypoint computes it.
